items.title: Howard Mandel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: Sound Aspects, that Dan Ouellette was editing for a couple of years had been a good outlet, now it’s gone.

ctx.x: Yeah. Is it harder to make a living as a jazz writer than it is as a jazz musician?

Well I’ve never been a jazz musician. I think that’s a pretty hard road to go too. Being friends with musicians, not just in jazz but contemporary composed music or chamber music, this is not an easy way to make a living. I do not find it easy to make a living as a jazz writer, no I don’t. I’ve been doing it for 26, 27 years now, it hasn’t gotten any easier. I think that in the last couple of years especially there has been a great sad drain of outlets. For a while when the dot com world was new and burgeoning…
